common.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update50000; Arb validation curves diagnostic only; no GSO-test selection

FM.loss: MSE + 0.25 unit-length penalty + 0.25 cosine penalty; applied to raw Xn before final unit normalization
FM.RGB_augmentation: horizontal spatial flip; normal x component sign flip, including cached normal condition

E1_B.description: FM with frozen MoGe-B geometry encoder
E1_B.initialization: Fresh seed1247; E1 holds D2 UNet init; E2 zero output residual and new coarse input weights; no D2 warmstart

E2_L.output_parameterization: raw Xn = coarse normal + learned residual; residual output weights and bias zero-initialized
changes_relative_D2: residual output parameterization and zero-initialized residual output layer
